query: WITH saudi_households AS (SELECT head_of_household_id, COUNT(id) as household_size FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala WHERE person_type = 'Saudi' AND person_status = 'صالح' AND death_date IS NULL GROUP BY head_of_household_id), foreigner_households AS (SELECT head_of_household_id, COUNT(id) as household_size FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala WHERE person_type = 'Alien' AND person_status = 'صالح' AND death_date IS NULL GROUP BY head_of_household_id) SELECT 'سعودي' as type, ROUND(AVG(household_size), 2) as avg_household_size FROM saudi_households UNION ALL SELECT 'أجنبي' as type, ROUND(AVG(household_size), 2) as avg_household_size FROM foreigner_households LIMIT 20000
